title: Magnet Fishing Kit 320lb – Neodymium Magnet with 10m Rope
descriptionHtml:
What is really hiding down there on the bottom?

Every pier, canal and swimming spot holds secrets. Bikes, tools, coins – sometimes things nobody has seen in fifty years. The question isn't whether you'll find something. The question is what.

The solution: throw it in, pull slowly, feel the bite

With 145 kg of pulling force in a magnet the size of a teacup, anything made of iron and steel hiding beneath the surface sticks to it. Magnet fishing is Sweden's fastest-growing hobby – and this is everything you need to get started.

Features

  • Lifts up to 145 kg (320 lb) – 48 mm neodymium magnet
  • Reaches the bottom – 10 meters of strong rope with a secure loop
  • Grip-friendly handle for heavy lifts
  • Handles lake water – protective coating against rust
  • Start right away – at lakes, piers, canals and beaches

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
